courses.summary: 傑克／聖馬洛的官方圖解介紹浮式生產單元與外輸管線；本課比較多來源處理與長距輸送的邊界。本課依序分析外輸管線液相損失、雙來源處理庫存、輸送壓差與功率、處理模組重量、來源分配與出口總量，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Chevron’s public diagram describes Jack/St Malo’s floating unit and export pipeline; this case compares multi-source processing with long-distance transfer. The course analyses liquid losses in export piping, processing inventory for two sources, transfer pressure difference and power, processing-module weight, source allocation and export total, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
